rows.note: Use 責任 as the all-purpose choice for a personal, social, or moral obligation.

example.english: Looking after my parents is my obligation.
example.traditional: 照顧父母係我應有嘅責任。
example.jyutping: ziu3 gu3 fu6 mou5 hai6 ngo5 jing1 jau5 ge3 zaak3 jam6

rows.note: Use 義務 for an explicit legal, contractual, or institutional duty, especially in formal contexts.

example.english: Under the contract, tenants have an obligation to pay rent on time.
example.traditional: 按照合約，租客有義務準時交租。
example.jyutping: on3 ziu3 hap6 joek3 zou1 haak3 jau5 ji6 mou6 zeon2 si4 gaau1 zou1
